why.B4.2: Single S2, systolic ejection murmur, and enlarged cardiac silhouette with increased pulmonary vasculature are consistent with Truncus Arteriosus

The combination of a single S2, systolic ejection murmur, enlarged cardiac silhouette, and increased pulmonary vasculature is highly suggestive of truncus arteriosus, a condition where a single great vessel arises from the heart, resulting in increased blood flow to the lungs.
